name: Storm Domingos, Nov 2023
description: Wind speed footprints for low-pressure system Domingos, which affected parts of Western Europe on November 4-7 2023 (events 4-6). Three footprints represent the uncertainty in the wind field: they are interpolated from UK Met Office station data using the nearest 15, 30 and 40 stations, giving progressively smoother wind fields.
